verdict.rationale: Lago's docs confirm webhooks for subscription/invoice lifecycle events with HMAC signing, automatic retries (3 attempts on failure), and a webhook log for inspecting/retrying failed deliveries, plus API versioning guarantees that new webhook event types are additive and won't break clients. Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated list of all lifecycle event types (renewal, upgrade, cancellation, payment failure) confirmed to each trigger a distinct webhook, and independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability in production.
